params.name: origin
params.description: The origin (source) image URL appended as the request path.

params.name: w
params.description: Target width in pixels (alias of width).

params.name: h
params.description: Target height in pixels (alias of height).

params.name: func
params.description: Resize function applied when both width and height are provided. crop is the default.

params.name: gravity
params.description: Focal point used when cropping. Accepts compass values ([north|south][east|west]), center, auto, smart, face, or X,Y coordinates.

params.name: org_if_sml
params.description: When set to 1, prevents upscaling beyond the original dimensions.

params.name: tl_px
params.description: Top-left corner X,Y coordinates for a positionable crop.

params.name: br_px
params.description: Bottom-right corner X,Y coordinates for a positionable crop.

params.name: flip
params.description: Mirror the image horizontally (h), vertically (v), or both (hv).

params.name: r
params.description: Rotate the image counterclockwise by the given number of degrees.

params.name: trim
params.description: Remove solid-color borders; value sets aggressiveness.

params.name: radius
params.description: Round image corners by the given radius (optionally with a fill color).

params.name: force_format
params.description: Force the output format (alias of format / f).

params.name: q
params.description: Output compression quality (1-100).

params.name: blur
params.description: Apply a Gaussian blur of the given strength.

params.name: sharpen
params.description: Apply sharpening of the given strength.

params.name: contrast
params.description: Adjust image contrast.

params.name: saturate
params.description: Adjust image saturation.

params.name: greyscale
params.description: Convert the image to greyscale when set to 1.

params.name: pixellate
params.description: Apply a pixelation effect of the given strength.

params.name: bg_remove
params.description: Remove the background using AI when set to 1 (consumes a visual operation).

params.name: wat
params.description: Enable a watermark overlay when set to 1.

params.name: wat_url
params.description: URL of the image to use as a watermark (defines a dynamic watermark).

params.name: wat_text
params.description: Text content for a text watermark.

params.name: wat_gravity
params.description: Watermark position (e.g. northeast, center).

params.name: wat_scale
params.description: Watermark scale relative to the image.

params.name: wat_pad
params.description: Watermark padding from the edge.

params.name: wat_opacity
params.description: Watermark opacity (0-100).

params.name: ci_url_encoded
params.description: Set to 1 when the origin URL is percent-encoded in the path.

items.docs: Requests the origin image and applies transformation operations supplied as query parameters. The origin image URL is carried as the request path (e.g. https://{token}.cloudimg.io/https://samples.scaleflex.com/flat.jpg). When the origin contains a query string or reserved characters, percent-encode it and add ci_url_encoded=1.
